items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions the 'Benny Moten Band' in the context of Count Basie taking it over, but does not state a personal relationship with Benny Moten himself.

ctx.x: There were certain type of men that he wanted in that band to make like a family -- like Duke was a big family band. Everybody (Inaudible) in the band were just like brothers, you know. Never heard no arguments dissension (inaudible) in Duke's band or Chick's band, you know.

You might've heard it in some other band, but not in those bands. (Inaudible) Basie, the Benny Moten Band out of Kansas City that Basie took over. I remember when they sent him out there to get that band.
